title: PlayerLogin/Register
description: This is an mc paper 1.21.X plugin that adds login and register in your mc server to keep it safe and not let anyone inpersonate
body:
This Plugin Adds Cmds Like
1./Register <Password> for players
2./login
3./resetpass <username> <newpass> (admin cmd)
There are features which include
1.If the player who registered once has b2b or more logins every day or more it wont ask for any login as it checks the ip change to auth the player
2.If the player dosent login for 2d or more it will ask for login(even if the player dosent under 2d and if the ip changes it will still ask for pass)
3.Ip changes are detected by the plugin and makes sure no one can hack anyones acc

More updates will come in future
Enjoy!
